description_en: Checks the status of the storage for the threat analysis feature. The storage is a Logstore in Simple Log Service
description_zh: 判断威胁分析用户的存储（用户侧日志服务中LogStore）是否正常
name: DescribeStorage

parameters.help_en:
The type of view. Valid values:

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member whose view you want to use. This parameter is available only for administrators
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select a region for the center based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are in the Chinese mainland or the China (Hong Kong) region.

ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are in regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the project and Logstore created by the threat analysis service exist in your Simple Log Service. Valid values:

true: The project and Logstore exist.

false: The project and Logstore do not exist
Data.description_zh:
用户的日志服务中是否存在威胁分析服务创建的Project和LogStore。取值：
true：存在
false：不存在
